visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: ArrayDeque Instead of ArrayList.remove(0)
visualizerParams.problemDescription: An ArrayList is used as a queue by removing index 0 each time, which shifts every other element. Use an ArrayDeque. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Removing the first element of an ArrayList moves all the others one place left, which takes n steps. An ArrayDeque removes from the front in constant time.
